items.title: Nvidia Stock And 2 US AI Infrastructure Plays Tied To Federal Defense Spending
items.summary: Washington just put AI and defense infrastructure back under a spotlight, with plans for an "AI Force" and an AI tsar signaling fresh attention on chips, cloud capacity and contractors that can plug into federal demand. That shift could reshape where capital flows next and it creates both openings and risks for investors watching AI-related equities. This article unpacks 3 US-listed large caps exposed to this policy theme and explains how each stock connects to the AI and defense spending...
